metadata.selection: 40 named UCL buildings and structures in the main Bloomsbury campus area. Adjacent non-UCL footprints are omitted. This is a curated subset, not a complete estate boundary.
metadata.geometry: Actual OSM way node coordinates, without simplification or invented footprints. Winding is normalised counterclockwise. Buildings use flat-top polygon extrusion, not surveyed 3D meshes.
metadata.height_policy: Use mapped height in metres when present; otherwise estimate building:levels × 3 metres. Missing height and levels use a clearly flagged illustrative 12 metre default. Roof shapes are not modelled.
metadata.rendering_note: Display all estimated heights as approximate. Keep OSM attribution visible on the map. The footprint extract is distributed under ODbL 1.0.
